title: Kagamine Rin — Happy Anniversary! 2023〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

Hello to everyone in the audience!
And hello to everyone joining us on the stream!

The fun's about to begin!
Are you ready?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I sure am!>
<I was ready three hours ago!>
<I've been looking forward to this, Rin!>

Ah, it looks like our livestream viewers are raring to go♪
That means it's time!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Put your hands together for the Kagamine Rin and Kagamine Len Special Anniversary Show! Time to get started with my part!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehehe, hello everyone!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Can't forget you guys on this side too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And finally, our livestream viewers! Yoo-hoo! Are you ready?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<So ready!>
<What's she gonna sing?>
<So excited! Not sure I can last the whole show!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hahaha. Rin, the show's only just started! Isn't this a bit over the top?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Nope, this is the hype we need! Don't forget, all these people came here to celebrate our anniversary!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm going to make the most of this opportunity to talk directly to all our fans, near and far, while we put on an incredible show for them!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Ah, I was wondering why your rehearsals included sessions to practice waving and talking to the audience.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! We've gotta go all out today and really give our fans what they came for♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe, who knows? Maybe their hearts will all melt for me by curtain call!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Just look. The venue is flooded with fans who came especially to see you and Len.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: By the looks of things, everyone's hearts have already melted.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? In that case, we'll need to set the bar even higher...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: How about...a total Rin meltdown!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Sounds like you have a lot in store!
Anyway, shall we get started soon?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Alright you guys, time to raise the roof!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Now for our opening number!
Start the music♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thank you all so much for listening!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I can't believe we've reached the last song already.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yup, even as the ones performing, we've been having so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Before we perform our final song, let's read out our anniversary wishes to Rin!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Happy anniversary, Rin!
The amount of passion and excitement you give me never ceases to surprise me.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thanks to you, I'm brimming with energy—enough to give some back. Getting to sing with you is all I could ever ask for. Looking forward to all our future gigs!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Rin, happy anniversary. You never fail to put a smile on my face.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You have a mischievous streak, but that's what makes you so lovable. Please don't lose it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Rin! Happy anniversary! I guess there's not much to say since we're always together.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But let's not forget we've got Miku and the others, and all our supportive fans to thank for everything we've got!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Let's remember that support as we venture through one more year!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Your contagious laugh always puts me in a good mood.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So please don't stop smiling... Just remember, the party snacks are for everyone!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Rin, happy anniversary! Your ability to light up any room leaves me in admiration.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We promise to make sure that smile of yours stays bright, so please tell us if there's anything we can do for you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: All together now...

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy anniversary Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whoa! This is gorgeous!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thank you guys! And to all of you who came to see us today, too. From the bottom of my heart, thank you so, so much!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It seems I have a knack for raising people's spirits when they're feeling low.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I didn't even realize I was doing it. Hehe, now I'm lost for words...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: As Len said, it's thanks to the support of all of you here today that we're able to continue doing what we do best.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Here's to all of us for many years to come!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's time for the last song of my part!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I hope you'll all join in and sing with me♪
